source.published_checksum_status: No checksum link on the accessible official dataset/download pages; directory metadata remains unavailable. A locally computed hash is an acquisition identity, not a publisher checksum or signature.
source.evidence_role: Previously unevaluated recording. Official description says a second recording of the same four desks; no independent physical room or automotive environment claim.

selection.rgb: nearest timestamp over complete original RGB table; earlier original index wins an exact tie
selection.frame_roles: initialization then independent_recording for all remaining 179 frames

acquisition_bounds.allowed_member_types: regular files and directories only; reject traversal, links, duplicate paths, foreign root, and nonfinite/negative sizes
acquisition_bounds.extraction: No blanket tar extraction. Scan bounded headers and opaque payloads; save only complete metadata first, then fixed qualified RGB/depth selection.

phase_order: Freeze source choice, window, unchanged estimator, gates and archive resource caps before new metadata or compressed archive acquisition.
Acquire official archive through inherited proxy with TLS verification. Preserve final URL and exact size, computed SHA256 and MD5; check any authoritative checksum before use, never invent one.

Inventory bounded archive and read complete depth/RGB indices plus only timestamp and arity of complete ground truth. Compressed image bytes are acquired and archive payloads decompressed, but PNG headers/pixels and numeric pose columns remain uninterpreted.
Qualify complete source ordering, finite timestamps, nearest RGB gaps <=0.02s, and all fixed-window GT brackets <=0.02s without extrapolation. Preserve failure without changing the source/window.

Only after qualification, copy fixed selected opaque image bytes. Bind per-file hashes, original source paths and archive identity in manifest; seal code/configuration/source/qualification freeze before decoding.
Run every operational fit with one camera root. Parse numeric reference poses only after all fits, then independently score and audit every update.

estimator.basis: Original temporal descriptor/depth/reprojection path; no depth-supported matching or Lucas-Kanade variant
estimator.defaults: Unchanged Rust ImageFeatureConfig, VisualOdometry3dConfig and ReprojectionConfig3d defaults; fixed before new data; full values included in pre-pixel source freeze
estimator.repeat_guard: Compare against last observed RGB acquisition; rejected observations cannot be retried or renew accepted pose
estimator.expiry: Accepted-pose expiry checked before RGB freshness and latches Lost; no restart
estimator.depth: All nine integer-nearest patch samples valid, 0.3..5 metres, spread <=0.05m, units5000/m
estimator.refinement_failure: Reject without coarse fallback, root output, or accepted-reference/clock renewal
estimator.origin: One measured initial camera origin; previous_from_current accepted poses composed into root

accuracy.criterion: Every update accepted and root accurate; preserve criterion even if duplicate source acquisitions make it structurally unattainable

manifest_contract.official_archive_values: URLs/root exactly source fields above; bytes positive <=compressed cap; lowercase SHA25664/MD532; published_checksum null unless explicit preregistered revision before data use
manifest_contract.calibration_source: Unchanged original TUM1 descriptor: repository luigifreda/pyslam, revision96019cfafcfc099ac9866884d7143a9ed1451a0d, source_path settings/TUM1.yaml, file camera-calibration.yaml, bytes1615, sha256 as profile above, role source_calibration_documentation_only. It is documentation only, outside raw files inventory.
manifest_contract.file_names: Flat depth-<original timestamp>.png/rgb-<original timestamp>.png and depth.txt/rgb.txt/groundtruth.txt; source_path is root-relative original depth/<timestamp>.png or rgb/<timestamp>.png or metadata name
manifest_contract.files: Exact distinct selected image files plus three complete metadata files; no extra or missing raw files; no Git-source identity

qualification_contract.metadata_files: Three exact name objects with bytes and sha256 only
qualification_contract.timestamps: Same exact timestamp-statistics schema as original temporal qualification; no Git hashes, no GT pose values
qualification_contract.false_flags_scope: Qualifier never opens selected PNG bytes; archive acquisition/decompression exposure is separately disclosed in acquisition log, not denied by these local flags

limitations: Offline indoor independent recording only; not independent physical environment, automotive confidence, calibrated uncertainty, vehicle integration, or a 30-percent maturity gate. Preserve all prior sources/archives/results byte-exact.
